    heard as: "Diet-wise, um, I want you to eliminate acidic and spicy triggers, cut out late meals, and remain upright for 3 hours post-meal, okay?"

statement the speaker makes, in the order spoken, with the note section it belongs to.
Return STRICT JSON only (no prose, no markdown):
{"parts": [{"quote": "...", "section": "..."}]}

Sections:
- present_illness: each symptom the patient has, with its duration, one per item (prefix DENIED: if marked DENIED)

- plan_of_management: prescribed drugs with dose/unit/frequency PLUS follow-up plans, referrals and therapy (prefix "NOT GIVEN: " if marked NOT GIVEN)
- diet_instructions: ONLY diet/food/fluid advice actually spoken, else []
- general_instructions: allergy statements (prefix DENIED if denied) and other spoken advice

Rules (must follow):
- quote MUST be copied EXACTLY from the transcript - a verbatim substring, misspellings
  included - and be the shortest stretch that states one fact.
- One fact per part: split a list ("avoid X, take Y, call Z") into separate parts.
- Skip small talk, greetings, section headings ("for the plan") and statements that
  only deny something ("no fever", "denies chest pain").
- section MUST be one of the six names above.
